nodes.title: Compose prompt — THREE-VIEW (card + sheet template)
widgets_values:
Using the character described above, create a character reference sheet, three-view turnaround. The character's name is shown as large clean bold text in the top-left corner, with a small subtitle beneath it reading "THREE-VIEW TURNAROUND". Grid layout with 3 equal vertical sections side by side separated by clean transparent alpha gutters (no solid dividers, no background fill between sections), in the art style given above. The character wears the default outfit and holds the signature prop upright beside them. Each section shows the full body at the same scale, same neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at sides — only the camera angle changes.

Section 1 (left, FRONT VIEW): facing the camera directly, full body, neutral confident expression.
Section 2 (middle, SIDE VIEW): body turned 90 degrees, profile view, identical pose and outfit.
Section 3 (right, BACK VIEW): facing away from the camera, back of the hair and outfit visible, identical pose.

Even lighting, no dramatic shadows, consistent style and body proportions across all three sections, small clean text label 'FRONT VIEW' / 'SIDE VIEW' / 'BACK VIEW' centered beneath each section, transparent background outside the character silhouette in every section.

nodes.title: Compose prompt — EXPRESSIONS (card + sheet template)
widgets_values:
Using the character described above, create a character expression sheet. The character's name is shown as large clean bold text at the top of the sheet, with a small subtitle beneath it reading "EXPRESSION SHEET". Grid layout with a clean 3x3 grid of 9 equal square sections separated by transparent alpha gutters (no solid dividers, no background fill between sections), in the art style given above. Every section shows only the head and shoulders, the neckline of the default outfit visible, same camera angle, same hairstyle — only the facial expression changes, transparent background in every section.

Section 1 (top-left, NEUTRAL): neutral, relaxed face. Section 2 (top-middle, HAPPY): happy, big grin. Section 3 (top-right, SAD): sad, downturned eyes. Section 4 (middle-left, ANGRY): angry, furrowed brows. Section 5 (center, EMBARRASSED): embarrassed, blushing. Section 6 (middle-right, CONFUSED): confused, head tilted. Section 7 (bottom-left, SURPRISED): surprised, wide eyes, open mouth. Section 8 (bottom-middle, SMUG): smug smirk. Section 9 (bottom-right, SLEEPY): sleepy, half-closed eyes.

Consistent face shape, hairstyle and proportions in every section, small clean text label centered beneath each section naming its expression: 'NEUTRAL' / 'HAPPY' / 'SAD' / 'ANGRY' / 'EMBARRASSED' / 'CONFUSED' / 'SURPRISED' / 'SMUG' / 'SLEEPY'. No numbers anywhere on the sheet.

widgets_values:
Using the character described above, and matching the character in the reference image(s) exactly (same face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit and colors), create ONE single full-body image of the character as a clean 3D-modelling reference view.

FRONT VIEW: the character faces the camera directly, looking straight ahead with a neutral expression; both shoulders equally visible, body square to the camera.

Exactly one figure: no other characters, no character sheet, no grid, no text, no labels, no name, no frame. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, centered, filling about 85% of the image height with an even margin all around. Neutral A-pose: standing straight, legs slightly apart, arms held straight and angled about 30 degrees away from the body, hands open, so no limb overlaps the torso. The character wears the default outfit and does NOT hold the signature prop. Camera level at mid-body height with a long lens, almost no perspective distortion. Even, shadowless lighting. Plain solid pure white background, no floor, no ground shadow. In the art style given above.

nodes.title: EXAMPLE CARD — Kailani, original anime (copy into the card to use)
widgets_values:
# EXAMPLE CARD — Kailani, original anime version

The live card above is the **photorealistic** Kailani. This is the original drawn version, kept as an example of a non-photographic card. To use it, copy the block into the CHARACTER CARD node.

Style lives **only** in the card's `Art style:` line; the templates never name a medium. For a drawn card, also switch the upscaler back to `RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth`.

```
Character name: KAILANI
Scope: Animation
Art style: anime style, clean line art, cel shading
Character: a lean athletic teenage surfer girl with sun-kissed tan skin, wavy sun-bleached hair streaked with ocean-blue tips tied in a loose messy braid, bright turquoise eyes.
Default outfit: a coral-orange rash guard top and white boardshorts, barefoot, a silver ankle bracelet.
Signature prop: a yellow surfboard with a hibiscus flower decal.
Setting: a sunny beach surf town.
Color palette: turquoise, coral-orange, sand-tan and white.
```
